notes.title: Revenguard Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello!
We are happy to announce that the official release date of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2418680/Revenguard/]Revenguard[/url] on Steam is today, August 25, 2023!

We are very excited to finally announce the official release date of our Revenguard game. Our team has been working hard to make the game the best it can be. The game contains a very rich story that will be developed in the next installments of the Revenguard series.

How to get free access to Revenguard?
If you are a content creator or manage to find us while promoting our Revenguard game, we are able to give you free access. We are a start-up development team focused on developing computer games. Any promotion of our products would help us a lot and improve our overall results in development and beyond. The Revenguard game would provide content for your business and would help us greatly. If you are interested, we would love to work with you. Contact us at this email address: galacticgames.business@gmail.com

For more information on the release, please visit our [url=https://discord.gg/bWdjXj9Udt]Discord server[/url] and our social media channels such as [url=https://www.instagram.com/galacticgames.off/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@galacticgames.off]TikTok[/url].

Have a great galactic day!

- Galactic Games Team

notes.title: Revenguard Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello there! 
On behalf of the entire Galactic Games team, we would like to announce that the release date of our latest video game "[b]Revenguard[/b]" will have to be moved to the second half of August 2023. 

We are very sorry about this. The development of our video game "Revenguard" has been delayed quite a bit lately. At the same time, we don't think "Revenguard" is ready to go out into the world. Revenguard still has a lot of flaws that the whole Galactic Games team is trying to fix. 

[b]For content creators:[/b]
At the same time we want to announce that we will be launching a test version for streamers, youtubers and all content creators sometime in early August. If you are a content creator and want to be one of the first to play "Revenguard" please contact us at this email address: [b]galacticgames.business@gmail.com[/b] or contact the admins of our [b]Discord server: https://discord.gg/bWdjXj9Udt[/b]

[b]You can find us here:[/b]
[b]Instagram:[/b] https://www.instagram.com/galacticgames.off/
[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/bWdjXj9Udt
[b]TikTok:[/b] https://www.tiktok.com/@galacticgames.off
[b]Steam:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43519957

We will keep you updated about the development of the video game "Revenguard" on our social networks like [b]Instagram[/b] or [b]Discord[/b]. 
[b]Have a Galactic Day![/b]
